summary: The Phase A design is compatible with LAUNCH-001's approved requirements, Vercel Hobby plus Supabase Free/Cron architecture, governed role-projection contracts, high-risk trust boundaries, established Clinical Glass design system, and required responsive, accessible, reduced-motion, provider-recovery, evidence, and privacy states. The two reported contract blockers were reconciled before approval: staff/transport projections now expose durable provider reconciliation state, and a revoked caregiver projection omits transport logistics at the server boundary.
review_scope: Compatibility only. Do not substitute orchestrator aesthetic preferences for frontend specialist design authority.
notes_for_frontend: The frontend specialist retains visual and interaction authority. Implement the exact approved report using the established design system; the scheduler infrastructure amendment does not alter the approved visual direction.

Sync the feature branch before Phase B and regenerate the OpenAPI client. Staff communication and transport projections now include ProviderReconciliationSummary and outcome_unknown; render only the contract-declared permitted recovery and never enable blind resend.

CaregiverProjection now has permission-granted and permission-revoked variants. When transport_logistics_allowed is false, transport is absent from the response; render the privacy-locked state without retaining or mounting prior logistics.
Vercel Hobby and Supabase Cron are operational implementation details. User-facing surfaces should continue to present truthful workflow state rather than infrastructure or rapid-delivery language.
Run the frontend design gate after sync and before production frontend edits. Any change to frontend-design-report.json after this approval requires a fresh exact-digest review.
